::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Shenzhen's second 12-inch wafer fab (after SMIC Shenzhen), part of Guangdong's push to give the province a 'third pole' of chip manufacturing; ¥22 billion phase-1 total, with CR Micro contributing ¥2.475 billion cash into the ¥15 billion-capital Runpeng JV.
:::

**Chinese name:** 润鹏半导体（深圳）有限公司 (Rùn Péng Bàndǎotǐ (Shēnzhèn))

## What does this facility make?

12-inch analog/mixed-signal specialty wafers (power management, BCD, RF) for consumer, industrial and automotive customers.

## Why does it matter?

Line activated 31 December 2024 and was reported at ~15,000 wafers/month by Q1 2026, targeting full 40,000/month by 2027 — a real-time case study of how long (2-3 years) a greenfield specialty 12-inch line actually takes to ramp.
